definitions.explanation: The act of making a reservation or appointment by telephone, or a reservation made in this way.

examples.japanese: {電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I make a reservation by phone?

examples.japanese: ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I called the restaurant to make a reservation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けて→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧⟦おりません→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧お⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We do not accept same-day phone reservations, so please book online.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (telephone) and ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation). Refers specifically to reservations made by phone as opposed to online booking ({ネット予約|ねっとよやく}) or walk-in (⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}み→飛び込み：07114_tobikomi⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to make a phone reservation
- {電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧: to accept phone reservations
- {電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: phone reservation only
- {電話予約|でんわよやく}⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: phone reservations not accepted

USAGE:
While online booking has become dominant, many traditional Japanese restaurants (⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧), medical clinics, and service providers still require or prefer {電話予約|でんわよやく}. Signs or websites often specify the accepted reservation methods.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {ネット予約|ねっとよやく}: online reservation, increasingly the default method
- ⟦{事前予約|じぜんよやく}→事前予約：22770_jizenyoyaku⟧: advance reservation, regardless of method
